items.title: Eddie Alley interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: Well during the war years my brother and Eddie Royal and Marshall Royal, they were in the Navy and they stayed here and they came to San Francisco for the gigs. So I was playing in a place called the Club Alabam. So they played with me at the Club Alabam.

ctx.x: Well during the war years my brother and Eddie Royal and Marshall Royal, they were in the Navy and they stayed here and they came to San Francisco for the gigs. So I was playing in a place called the Club Alabam. So they played with me at the Club Alabam. So all these great musicians played with me. And then Mingus was one of the greatest musicians you know. But he was a nut later on, Mingus.
What was he like when you knew him?
